integrity: Theoretical proof by orbit simplices, three-step graph folds, and an apex homotopy-cofiber calculation; finite checks are confirmatory, not an unrestricted proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For the two conjugacy classes of base-cycle reflections and all generalized Mycielskian depths >=1; does not determine the whole ambient equivariant homotopy type, other subgroups, or actions on ambient integral homology. Novelty remains subject to unindexed equivalent results.
title: Reflection-axis dichotomy for generalized Mycielskians of the six-cycle
